selection_rule: For each site, among WAV files named <site>_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>.WAV, select the file on the date (first recorded date + 1 day(s)) whose recorder-clock time is nearest 12:00:00; if no files exist on that date, fall forward to the next date that has files; ties resolve to the earlier time. Offset into the selected file is 15.0s, excerpt duration is 30.0s.
timezone_note: Filename timestamps are the recorder clock; timezone unverified until Phase 8 (DATA-02).
